record.title: Bio-Based Rigid Polyurethane Foam Composites Reinforced with Bleached Curauá Fiber
claim_notes: Członka, Fischer Kerche, Motta Neves, Strąkowska and Strzelec (2021), International Journal of Molecular Sciences 22(20), 11203. Copyright 2021 by the authors; licensee MDPI, Basel, Switzerland.
Article-specific CC BY 4.0 on publisher PDF page 1 and in the official archive permissions. Retain the five authors and license link; Xiao Hu and Antonella Piozzi are academic editors, not authors.

Changes: selected nominal formulation, state and measured apparent-density facts transcribed into structured candidate records with explicit unknowns, literal variability annotations and source qualifications. No author or publisher endorsement is implied.
No separate restriction was observed for selected Table 2 and methods; no referenced third-party tables are imported.

provenance.method: Publisher-hosted PDF and official Europe PMC XML were downloaded and their exact bytes hashed. The publisher PDF was visually checked on pages 1, 5, 7 and 10-12 for the five authors, article-specific CC BY 4.0 notice, Table 2 density means, literal superscripts and group letters, preparation, density method, sample count and curing-age conflict. Selected facts were cross-checked against the official XML. Neither an archive version nor a PDF manifest was found in the XML; neither is claimed. This is source transcription review, not scientific replication, independent scientific review or legal clearance.

product_form.text: Freely expanded rigid polyurethane foam composite, cut after preparation.
product_form.notes: Density specimen dimensions are not stated.

processing.text: Bleached Curauá pulp was cut and minced, mixed into the polyol system, then mixed with MDI and allowed to grow freely in an open plastic box in the vertical direction.
processing.notes: Source formulation and processing are not an independently verified final chemical composition.

temper_or_heat_treatment.text: Prepared foams were cured at room conditions for 24 h before cutting.

evidence.locator: Section 3.2, final preparation sentences; PDF p.11

temper_or_heat_treatment.notes: Section 3.2 reports room-condition curing for 24 h before cutting; Section 2 thermal-conductivity discussion describes the studied foams as post-cured for at least 7 days. The density measurement age and relation of these stages are unresolved. Neither 24 h nor 7 days is assigned as density measurement age.

conditioning.notes: Section 3.2 reports room-condition curing for 24 h before cutting; Section 2 thermal-conductivity discussion describes the studied foams as post-cured for at least 7 days. The density measurement age and relation of these stages are unresolved. Neither 24 h nor 7 days is assigned as density measurement age.

porosity.notes: No porosity value is selected. Apparent density does not establish true solid density or zero porosity; no estimate from closed-cell data is made.

orientation.notes: Scalar density has no mechanical loading direction; vertical rise is preparation context, not a claim of material isotropy.

apparent_density.basis_note: Table 2 apparent-density means; its footnote identifies statistical comparisons between means. Section 3.2 reports mass divided by volume for ten samples per group according to ISO 845.

temperature.notes: Density measurement temperature is not stated. Room conditions for curing and temperatures for viscosity or thermal-conductivity tests are not transferred.

test_standard.notes: Edition and extra standard-derived test conditions are not supplied.

test_method.text: Ratio of foam mass to volume.
test_method.notes: No helium-pycnometer attribution: the next sentence assigns that instrument to closed-cell content, a different measurement.

direction.notes: Mechanical loading direction is not applicable to this scalar density result.

conditioning.notes: Section 3.2 reports room-condition curing for 24 h before cutting; Section 2 thermal-conductivity discussion describes the studied foams as post-cured for at least 7 days. The density measurement age and relation of these stages are unresolved. Neither 24 h nor 7 days is assigned as density measurement age. Density humidity and conditioning schedule are not stated.

loading_rate.notes: Mechanical loading rate is not applicable to density.

fact.notes: Density pressure is not stated; no ambient numerical default is assigned.

Section 3.2 reports room-condition curing for 24 h before cutting; Section 2 thermal-conductivity discussion describes the studied foams as post-cured for at least 7 days. Ten density samples per group are reported; repeat readings per specimen and independent foam-production batches are not stated.

sample_count.scope: Ten samples per group for apparent-density measurement. Independent specimens from separately produced batches and repeat readings per sample are not specified.
sample_count.source_statement: RPUF apparent density: 10 samples for each group.

method_definition.definition: Foam mass divided by volume, according to source-cited ISO 845. No standard-derived numerical conditions are inferred.
